## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm verify` is green (build, typecheck, tests).
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change.
- [ ] No secret value, token or key in code, tests, fixtures, logs, screenshots or this description; new responses and errors have a test that no value appears.
- [ ] Documentation updated (`docs/`, README, `CHANGELOG.md` under *Unreleased*).
- [ ] UI texts added to both `messages/*.de.ts` and `messages/*.en.ts`; new backend messages added to `packages/runtime/src/i18n-en.ts`.
- [ ] Policy for agents unchanged, or the change is explained and tested (agents never confirm, never see values).
- [ ] For a browser recipe: provider page and date tested, supervised or not, `# STATUS` comment updated.
